description: Change fields on a saved company (id from list_companies). Only the fields passed change. A draft already linked to the company picks up the change when company_id is passed again or the draft is opened on arcangel.ai. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

address_line2.description: Suite or unit. null clears it.

country.description: Country of the address, e.g. United States.

entity_type.description: c_corp, s_corp, llc, llp, lp (limited partnership), general_partnership, sole_proprietorship, nonprofit or other.

legal_name.description: Registered legal name, e.g. "Lumora Labs LLC".

registered_state.description: US state where the company is registered (formed), e.g. Delaware. Can differ from the address.

state_province.description: State or province of the address.

name: update_company
title: Edit a saved company
